rules: Domain choices are horizontally scrollable and never shrink to force all choices into one row.
Project period appears as supporting metadata beside the project context and is not repeated in the detail grid.
Dynamic Team impact items consume the same popup padding and text-rhythm tokens as static cards.
The close button traverses the detail stack; clicking the dialog backdrop closes the complete stack.
Supporting-case actions align to the bottom edge of comparable cards.
Experiment, side-project, playground, and related-work rails share equal edge padding, fixed card widths, and native scroll snapping.
